question: A man spends 20% of his monthly salary on the rent of his house. If every month he also spends ₹600 on his conveyance and ₹3,500 on his grocery and saves the remaining ₹500 , his monthly salary is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Salary = 100%

Rent = 20% | Remaining = 100% − 20% = 80%

Sum of non-rent values = 600 (Conveyance) + 3500 (Grocery) + 500 (Savings) = ₹4,600

80% of Salary = 4,600

100% of Salary = (4,600 ÷ 80) × 100 = 57.5 × 100 = ₹5,750

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

House Rent = 20% of Salary

Conveyance = ₹600

Grocery = ₹3,500

Savings = ₹500

**Formula Used:**

Total Salary = Rent + Conveyance + Grocery + Savings

 Monthly Salary Distribution (100%)
 
 
 Rent
 20%
 Conveyance + Grocery + Savings
 80% = ₹4,600
 
• 
 Total Salary (x) = ?

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total monthly salary be x.

⇒ Expenditure on Rent = 20% of x = 0.20x

⇒ Sum of Conveyance, Grocery, and Savings = 600 + 3,500 + 500 = ₹4,600

⇒ Total Salary − Rent = Conveyance + Grocery + Savings

⇒ x − 0.20x = 4,600

⇒ 0.80x = 4,600

⇒ x = 4,600 ÷ 0.80

⇒ x = 46,000 ÷ 8

⇒ x = 5,750

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Income-Expenditure Relation

Income = Total Expenditure + Savings. This is the fundamental equation for all salary-based problems.

Percentage Expenditure

If p% is spent on one item, then the remaining percentage is (100 − p)%. The absolute value of the remaining amount can be equated to this remaining percentage.

Successive Percentage Method

If a man spends x% of salary and then y% of the **remaining** salary, the final savings = Total × (100 − x)/100 × (100 − y)/100.
